ttTitle: The follow-up message after a career fair

ig.alt: Career fair season. What to send the day after you meet someone. One follow-up message, line by line, and what to do if they don’t reply. Example follow-up message to Priya: Hi Priya, it’s Sam from Thursday’s career fair. We talked about your team’s move to Chicago while we were stuck in the coffee line. Sam.
